scripts.build: npm run build -w narrarium && npm run build -w narrarium-engine && npm run build -w narrarium-sdk && npm run build -w narrarium-mcp-server && npm run build -w narrarium-astro-reader && npm run build -w create-narrarium-book && npm run build -w narrarium-server && npm run build -w narrarium-site
scripts.pack:all: npm pack --dry-run -w narrarium && npm pack --dry-run -w narrarium-engine && npm pack --dry-run -w narrarium-sdk && npm pack --dry-run -w narrarium-mcp-server && npm pack --dry-run -w narrarium-astro-reader && npm pack --dry-run -w create-narrarium-book && npm pack --dry-run -w narrarium-server
scripts.release:check: npm run dependency:check && npm run build && npm run validate && npm run test && npm run pack:all
scripts.sync:script-ledger: npm run build -w narrarium --silent && node scripts/sync-script-ledger.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts e2e/app-entry.spec.ts e2e/route-splitting.spec.ts e2e/paragraph-sync.spec.ts e2e/indexeddb-upgrades.spec.ts e2e/ai-calls.spec.ts e2e/costs-ledger.spec.ts e2e/costs-dashboard.spec.ts e2e/costs-budgets.spec.ts e2e/prompt-caching.spec.ts e2e/ai-routing.spec.ts e2e/responses-api.spec.ts e2e/autopilot-navigation.spec.ts e2e/autopilot-resume.spec.ts e2e/local-first.spec.ts e2e/brainstorming.spec.ts e2e/synopsis-apply.spec.ts e2e/review-campaigns.spec.ts e2e/review-targets.spec.ts e2e/review-reading.spec.ts e2e/annotations.spec.ts e2e/design-run.spec.ts e2e/repository-conflicts.spec.ts e2e/page-copilot.spec.ts e2e/copilot-apply.spec.ts e2e/long-paste.spec.ts e2e/google-scopes.spec.ts e2e/reader-run.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:basename: SITE_BASE=/GhostWriterFramework/ NARRARIUM_E2E_BUILD=1 VITE_E2E=true npm run bms:build && SITE_BASE=/GhostWriterFramework/ playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts e2e/route-splitting.spec.ts e2e/paragraph-sync.spec.ts --grep 'public home|public docs|login loads|finite public routes|route families'
scripts.test: npm run test -w narrarium && npm run test -w narrarium-engine && npm run test -w narrarium-sdk && npm run test -w narrarium-mcp-server && npm run test -w create-narrarium-book && npm run test -w narrarium-astro-reader && npm run test -w narrarium-server && npm run test -w narrarium-site
scripts.validate: npm run validate -w narrarium --if-present && npm run validate -w narrarium-engine --if-present && npm run validate -w narrarium-sdk --if-present && npm run validate -w narrarium-server --if-present
scripts.dependency:check: node --test scripts/workspace-publish.test.mjs scripts/fast-track.test.mjs && node scripts/check-dependency-policy.mjs && npm audit --audit-level=info && npm ls --depth=0
